scriptText:
I. PART I

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic dialogue scene featuring @actor1 as MARK (voice: @audio1), an obsessed young mathematics professor, and @actor2 as ROBERT (voice: @audio2), his senior mentor, set in a atmospheric university cafeteria as a physical demonstration of fluid dynamics transforms into a sharp personal confrontation.
[[/INTENT]]

[[LOGIC]]
Ensure precise spatial continuity across the narrow dark oak table axis, keeping Mark anchored on frame-left and Robert on frame-right. Maintain visual persistence of the condensation-coated iced coffee glass, porcelain milk pitcher, steaming tea mug, and handwritten notes across all cuts. Respect eyelines and preserve lighting contrast between cool daylight through the rainy window and warm overhead tungsten light.
[[/LOGIC]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Medium: 35mm atmospheric cinema lens with soft depth falloff and organic grain
Palette: Dark charcoal, muted rust orange, mahogany brown, forest green, warm tungsten yellow, cool slate blue
Lighting: Overhead brass pendant lamp casting warm pool of light on dark table, balanced against cool overcast daylight through rain-streaked window
Location: Secluded gothic university cafeteria corner with dark-stained oak paneling and heavy oak tables
Wardrobe: Mark in dark charcoal corduroy shirt over rust-orange crewneck with pushed-up sleeves and vintage wristwatch; Robert in navy turtleneck under forest-green Harris Tweed blazer with retro gunmetal glasses
Key Props: Tall iced black coffee glass with heavy condensation, small white porcelain milk pitcher, steaming ceramic tea mug, handwritten mathematical notes, fountain pen
Audio: Heavy rain drumming against glass pane, muted ceramic plate clatter, distant cafeteria murmur, steam hiss
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
Wide establishing shot of the secluded cafeteria booth. Rain streaks down tall gothic stone arch windows on frame-right. On a dark oak table illuminated by a low brass pendant lamp, a condensation-covered tall iced coffee glass sits beside a small white porcelain milk pitcher, while a steaming ceramic mug rests near scattered handwritten notes. Mark sits tense on frame-left, hunched forward, while Robert sits relaxed on frame-right, holding his mug.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 01] WS, stationary establishing shot -> [BLOCK] Mark leans over the dark table while Robert stays seated upright -> [ACT] Mark hovers the small white porcelain milk pitcher over the iced coffee glass -> <Pouring sound from pitcher spout> -> [STATE OUT] Pitcher positioned steadily over glass rim
[CAM 04] INS, high angle on coffee workspace -> [ACT] A single droplet of white milk falls from the spout into the dark liquid, fracturing into intricate branching tendrils -> Mark says (whispering with intense focus) {Same volume, same angle...} -> <Milk tendrils swirling inside dark coffee>
[CAM 02] MCU, camera over Robert's shoulder on Mark -> [STATE IN] Mark holding pitcher over glass -> [ACT] Mark keeps staring down at the swirling white fluid as he completes his thought -> Mark says (straining voice with quiet tension) {...and it never blooms the same way twice.} -> <Glass clink against dark oak as Mark sets pitcher down>
[CAM 03] MCU, camera over Mark's shoulder on Robert -> [STATE IN] Robert holding ceramic mug near chest -> [ACT] Robert takes a slow sip from his mug, lowers it gently to the table, and shifts his retro gunmetal glasses -> Robert says (speaking with calm warmth) {Because you moved the glass, Mark.} -> <Ceramic mug settles onto dark wood with soft clink>
[CAM 02] MCU, camera over Robert's shoulder on Mark -> [STATE IN] Mark looking down at coffee -> [ACT] Mark avoids eye contact, watching the white tendrils slowly fade -> Robert says O.S. (gentle voice) {Your hands are cold.} -> Mark shifts his posture, tensing his shoulders under his corduroy shirt
[CAM 04] INS, desktop workspace -> [STATE IN] Milk pitcher resting on wood next to condensation ring -> [ACT] Mark raises his right hand, spreading his fingers to trace fluid vectors in the air -> Mark says (muttering with quiet obsession) {It is not just my hands, Robert.} -> <Fingers tracing invisible vectors in air>
[CAM 01] MS, two-shot profile across table -> [STATE IN] Mark gesturing in air, Robert leaning back calmly -> [ACT] Mark leans forward into the warm light beam while gesturing toward the glass -> Mark says (speaking rapidly) {The initial state is a ghost. Miss the boundary condition by a millimeter, and the whole field fractures.} -> Mark lowers his hand, flattening his palm onto the dark oak table surface
[CAM 03] MCU, camera over Mark's shoulder on Robert -> [STATE IN] Robert leaning back comfortably -> [ACT] Robert rests his hand near his mug and smiles with knowing warmth -> Mark says O.S. (sighing with frustration) {It breaks apart every single time.} -> Robert tilts his head slightly, eyes narrowing with gentle wisdom
[CAM 03] MCU, camera over Mark's shoulder on Robert -> [STATE IN] Robert looking directly across table -> [ACT] Robert leans forward slightly, resting both forearms on the oak table -> Robert says (speaking with deliberate clarity) {Sounds like an expensive way of saying you can’t undo what you said at the board meeting.} -> <Heavy rain lashes against glass window>
[CAM 02] MCU, camera over Robert's shoulder on Mark -> [STATE IN] Mark frozen with palm flat on table -> [ACT] Mark freezes, his jaw tightening as his eyes widen in realization -> <Soft steam rising between them> -> Mark slowly lowers his gaze, breaking eye contact to look down at his cold coffee glass
[CAM 01] WS, framing booth through raindrops on glass window -> [STATE IN] Raindrops streaming down glass foreground, both men silhouetted inside -> [ACT] Robert takes another quiet sip from his mug while Mark remains motionless -> <Distant rain rumble and quiet room murmur>
[</BRIEF>]

II. PART II

[[STAGING]]
[[INTENT]]
Create a cinematic scene continuation extending directly from @video1, featuring @actor1 as MARK (voice: @audio1), a brilliant young mathematics professor struggling with loss, and @actor2 as ROBERT (voice: @audio2), his quiet senior colleague, as their tense academic dispute over fluid mechanics evolves into an intimate conversation inside a rain-soaked university cafeteria.
[[/INTENT]]

[[CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]
Ensure flawless state inheritance from @video1 by maintaining exact spatial geometry, lighting, character wardrobing, and prop placements across the dark oak booth. Preserve the spatial axis where Mark sits opposite Robert, taking care to mirror the horizontal orientation accurately when switching between exterior glass POV and interior table setups. Maintain continuous environmental lighting from the low brass pendant lamp balanced against cool grey overcast window daylight, keeping the spilled iced coffee, milk pitcher, and handwritten notes locked in their final positions from @video1.
[[/CONTINUITY PROTOCOL]]

[[AESTHETIC]]
Sounds: Diegetic Only. No Music, No BGM.
[[/AESTHETIC]]

[[OPENING]]
Extremely wide exterior shot framed through the heavy, rain-streaked stone arch window looking into the cafeteria booth. Outside, heavy rain streams down the dark glass pane, partially blurring the interior geometry where Robert sits on frame-left sipping from his warm ceramic tea mug and Mark sits motionless on frame-right with his palms resting flat on the dark oak table beside the spilled coffee puddle under the warm brass pendant glow.
[[/OPENING]]
[[/STAGING]]

[<BRIEF>]
[CAM 05] EWS, exterior static framing through rain-streaked window -> [STATE IN] Rain droplets trickling down glass pane, obscuring silhouettes inside -> [BLOCK] Robert sits frame-left holding his mug, Mark sits motionless frame-right with palms flat on the wet table -> [ACT] Mark leans forward slightly, his chest rising with an agitated breath -> <Distant rumble of rain outside> -> [STATE OUT] Interior warm lamp casting amber glow on their silhouetted profiles
[CAM 01] WS, interior two-shot profile across dark oak table -> [STATE IN] Mark leaning forward frame-left, Robert seated upright frame-right across from him -> [ACT] Mark shifts his fingers across the dark wood near the coffee stain -> Mark says (voice strained with rising desperation) {We pretend life is linear, but it is non-linear turbulence.} -> <Soft rustle of corduroy fabric>
[CAM 02] MCU, camera over Robert's shoulder on Mark -> [STATE IN] Mark staring intently across the table, shadow framing his jaw -> [ACT] Mark gesticulates slightly with his right hand over the spilled coffee -> Mark says (speaking rapidly, breath catching) {One tiny fluctuation...} -> Robert says O.S. (speaking softly with quiet melancholy) {...and a twenty-year marriage ends over an anniversary.} -> [ACT] Mark freezes his hand mid-air, his eyes wavering
[CAM 03] MCU, camera over Mark's shoulder on Robert -> [STATE IN] Robert holding his warm ceramic tea mug near his chest -> [ACT] Robert sets his ceramic mug down onto the wooden saucer with deliberate poise -> <Soft clink of ceramic against saucer> -> Robert says (speaking with steady, quiet gravity) {I know the math, Mark.} -> [ACT] Robert rests his hands flat on the table, watching Mark without blinking
[CAM 02] MCU, camera over Robert's shoulder on Mark -> [STATE IN] Mark hovering his hand above the table surface, shadow across his forehead -> [ACT] Mark lowers his hand onto the table edge, leaning further forward into the warm light beam -> Mark says (voice cracking slightly) {Then why keep building models?} -> <Heavy rain drumming softly against window glass>
[CAM 03] MCU, camera over Mark's shoulder on Robert -> [STATE IN] Robert sitting still, light reflecting off his tortoiseshell glasses -> [ACT] Robert slowly reaches up with both hands, unhooking his heavy tortoiseshell glasses and resting them on the wooden table -> <Soft metallic click of glass frame against oak> -> Robert says (speaking with calm vulnerability) {Because deterministic chaos is terrifying.} -> [ACT] Robert folds his fingers together, his unshielded eyes locked on Mark
[CAM 04] INS, high angle top-down view of desktop workspace -> [STATE IN] Glasses resting beside the condensation-covered glass and spilled coffee puddle -> [ACT] Shadow falls over the handwritten notes as Robert's gaze shifts down toward the liquid -> Robert says O.S. (sighing softly with weary honesty) {Drinking black coffee alone at sixty is a much easier curve to calculate.} -> <Quiet drizzle echoing off outer stone sill>
[CAM 02] MCU, camera over Robert's shoulder on Mark -> [STATE IN] Mark leaning forward with tight expression -> [ACT] Mark's jaw tightens as his breath hitches, his eyes shifting downward to break eye contact -> <Subdued exhaled breath> -> [ACT] Mark flattens his palms completely against the cold surface of the oak booth, remaining completely silent
[CAM 03] MCU, camera over Mark's shoulder on Robert -> [STATE IN] Robert sitting opposite with glasses resting on table -> [ACT] Robert slowly lifts his ceramic mug back toward his mouth, taking a quiet sip while keeping his gaze steady -> <Soft ceramic scraping against wood> -> [STATE OUT] Steam rising softly between their faces in the dim overhead light
[CAM 05] EWS, exterior static framing looking through heavy rain glass -> [STATE IN] Rainwater streaming down exterior stone wall and window glass -> [BLOCK] Robert frame-left holding mug at lip level, Mark frame-right motionless with lowered head -> [ACT] A heavy stream of water trails slowly down the central glass pane, blurring their dark profiles in the amber interior light -> <Deep rolling rain ambience>
[</BRIEF>]
